The body is made from the branches of a flexible tree that grows near water, which offers some serious destructive power.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 25 |durability = 35 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Strengthened Lizal Bow}} Strengthened Lizal Bows are upgraded [[Lizal Bow]]s with a grip reinforced by metal. Their wooden body is made from flexible [[Tree]]s that grow near [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], increasing their destructive power. They belong to the [[Lizalfos Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all [[Weapon]]s created by [[Lizalfos]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} They are commonly used by [[Blue Lizalfos]] on the [[Tabantha Frontier]] and in the [[Gerudo Desert]], but they are also found in the hands of [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]], [[Ice-Breath Lizalfos]], and [[Electric Lizalfos]]. While they do have metallic components, Strengthened Lizal Bows are considered wooden Weapons in the game. Therefore, they will burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They also float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. Finally, they cannot be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_011" |Life = 35 |Power = 25 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 10 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 18 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 3 |LeadShotAng = 13.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 2 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 25 |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Strengthened Lizal Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} Strengthened Lizal Bows reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Strengthened Lizal Bows reappear in {{AoC}}, being wielded by [[Lizalfos]] and their semi strongest variants.
